items.note: Replace a leaking water pump at the same time, since it sits right above the distributor.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or losing 3rd and 4th gear
items.note: Minor shift problems from a valve body or sensor fault cost far less. A used or remanufactured unit is another option.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak (3.8L V6)
items.job: Replace upper and lower intake manifold gaskets and coolant elbows
items.note: Change the oil afterward if coolant got into it.

items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: Cost rises a lot if overheating damaged the head gaskets or the Optispark.
Most owners live with the noise. Actually curing it means rebuilding the engine, which costs thousands.

items.t: Power windows slow down or stop working
items.note: Price is per door. A worn regulator adds parts cost.

items.t: Clutch release bearing noise and clutch wear (manual)
items.job: Replace clutch, release bearing and resurface or replace flywheel
items.note: A new clutch master or slave cylinder adds about $100-250.

items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
Replace radiator and flush cooling system
Replace ignition switch and lock cylinder
items.note: Testing the key and anti-theft system first may show a cheaper fix.

items.note: Pontiac is gone, but GM dealers can still check your VIN for open recalls.
